{{Quote|Most excellent!|Yoda|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
'''Bottom-feeder gumbo''' was a sticky, black, acrid stuff with nameless floating pale blobs that were the color of tree lichen. It smelled extraordinarily like burning lubricant. It was made of mixed [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] and otherwise useless [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. It only appealed to a small number of beings, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] among them.<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

It was served by the [[Tac-Spec Corporation|Tac-Spec]] [[FIII Footman droid]] [[Fidelis]] to Yoda aboard the ''[[Nighthawk]]'', a [[B-7 light freighter]] that Yoda purchased.<ref name="YDR" />
